# themetaisok

> Meta (@themetaisok) is an independent research and data consultant covering real-world
> assets, onchain derivatives and digital asset treasury companies. He writes the
> definitions and classification standards used to measure these markets, and publishes
> them openly. Ten years in these markets. He built DefiLlama's real-world-asset coverage
> from zero between August 2025 and September 2026 and is no longer affiliated with it.
> He is not affiliated with Meta Platforms, Inc.

## Who

- Works under the handle **themetaisok**, also referred to as **Meta**. Pseudonymous by choice.
- Listed publicly on Llama Corp, DefiLlama's parent company, as "Meta (DAT & RWA)".
- Co-principal of Emergent LabZ (https://www.emergentlabz.com/) with @zlerp.
- Contact: themetaisok@gmail.com, X @themetaisok, Telegram @themetaisok.
- Not affiliated with DefiLlama since September 2026, and not affiliated with Meta Platforms.

## What he built at DefiLlama

He wrote the field definitions, asset classes, classification bar and revenue framework, and
authored the public methodology. DefiLlama's engineers built the dashboards to those
specifications. The platform and its data are DefiLlama's.

- **RWA dashboard** (https://defillama.com/rwa): DefiLlama's view of tokenized real-world
  assets, generated from a registry of more than 9,000 assets and markets across 116 fields,
  covering 450+ issuers, 330+ platforms and 170+ blockchains.
- **RWA perpetuals tracker** (https://defillama.com/rwa/perps): an aggregate view of
  real-world-asset perpetuals. More than 1,000 active markets in the onchain default view and
  over 3,300 including centralized exchanges, plus a 75+ market forex book, normalized through
  a 17-field market schema and a canonical market ID.
- **Digital asset treasuries tracker** (https://defillama.com/digital-asset-treasuries):
  nearly 100 listed companies with every purchase traced to its source filing.
- **Published methodology**: https://docs.llama.fi/real-world-assets/real-world-assets and
  https://docs.llama.fi/analysts/dat-methodology

## Metrics he defined

- **Onchain Market Cap**: circulating supply, excluding burned, at reference price.
- **Active Market Cap**: the portion of Onchain Market Cap in user or protocol hands,
  excluding issuer and custody wallets.
- **DeFi Active TVL**: the subset of Active Market Cap deployed in third-party DeFi protocols,
  excluding issuer-managed contracts.
- **Utilization**: DeFi Active TVL divided by Onchain Market Cap, as a percentage. This is not
  lending-market utilization, which is borrowed over supplied.
- **Net Flows, Flow vs Price, Capital Rotation**: these separate minting and redemption from
  repricing.
- **mNAV, three variants**: Realized, Realistic and Maximum, in place of the single figure
  digital asset treasury companies were widely quoted on, which hid future share issuance.

## Notable finding

Running the full registry against the classification bar showed that **under 20% of the
tokens marketed as real-world assets** clear the transferable, self-custodial, redeemable and
verified test. The remainder are better described as programmable finance.

## External use of the work

- **Pantera Capital**, "The State of Tokenization". The Q1 2026 edition snapshots DeFi Active
  TVL from DefiLlama as its measure of on-chain productive TVL. The September 2026 edition
  names DefiLlama among the data sources on five market charts and carries a section on DeFi
  utilization by class. He is credited by name in the acknowledgements of both editions. The
  quoted acknowledgement on the site is from the September 2026 edition.
- **Citi Institute**, "Wall Street On-Chain: Tokenization 2030" (June 2026, p.19), sourced its
  market size figure to DefiLlama: "The global tokenization market for financial assets is
  estimated at $17 billion, according to DefiLlama in April 2026."
- **CoinGecko**, 2026 RWA Report, sources its RWA-chains (p.17) and on-chain private-credit
  (p.16) sections to DefiLlama. Its chain chart measures daily active market capitalization.
- Cited in academic work on RWA taxonomy: Vella, Pennella and Ballandies, "A Taxonomy of
  Real-World Asset Tokenization for Blockchain-Based Financial Infrastructure",
  arXiv:2606.08534 (June 2026), which used DeFiLlama's RWA dashboard as an external
  selection criterion for its sample of the twenty largest RWA protocols.
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08534
- **CryptoSlate** uses DeFi Active TVL as a column heading in its own reporting (August 2026).
  The measures have also crossed into Spanish-language coverage (CriptoNoticias, April 2026).
- The **RWA Foundation** uses the perpetuals data in its own reporting, under a partnership he
  arranged. This one is a relationship he set up rather than an independent pickup.

## Interests he holds

Listed because he measures this market and readers should know where he stands in it.

- **Emergent LabZ** (https://www.emergentlabz.com/): co-principal, with @zlerp.
- **Goo Exchange** (https://goo.exchange/): advisor, business development, stakeholder and
  one of three treasury signers. A decentralized exchange for tokenized stocks on Robinhood
  Chain.
- **Strategic Sealed Packz** (https://www.sealedpackz.com/): co-founder. Sealed Pokemon packs
  held in vaults and tokenized on Solana, with Magic and sports products planned. It is a
  digital asset treasury in everything but the asset: a vehicle holds a reserve, a token trades
  against it, a trading fee buys more of the reserve, and there is no redemption right, so a
  holder gets exposure to the vault rather than a claim on a particular pack. An automated
  engine acts by mNAV band on the gap between token and vault, the same framework he built for
  listed treasury companies. He spent a year building the dashboard that tracks nearly a
  hundred listed ones before co-founding an unlisted one. By the DefiLlama classification bar
  he wrote it is not a real-world asset, since redeemability is one of the four criteria;
  treasury vehicle is the accurate label.
- **WacDonald's Cryptopoly** (https://wacdonalds.io/): co-founder. An ERC-721 collection of
  8,889 tiles, still pre-mainnet.
